C0442.title: F5 Defends Against Gift Card Cracking Attacks
C0442.summary: A luxury brand faced automated gift card cracking attacks, with attackers brute-forcing balance inquiries and checkout balance applications at 100 times the frequency of legitimate customers. After deploying F5 Distributed Cloud Bot Defense, the attacks ceased, and 98.5% of gift card balance inquiry traffic was identified as automated requests.

references.title: Prevent Gift Card Cracking: Brute Force Enumeration - F5
